description: Source code implementing parsing and handling of cryptographic signature algorithms, including OID definitions, ASN.1 parsing, and RSA/ECDSA signature algorithm support within the Chromium project.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is empty.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the input is a NULL ASN.1 value.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is NULL or empty.

methods.name: ParseMaskGenAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses a Mask Generation Function AlgorithmIdentifier, supporting only MGF1.

methods.name: ParseRsaPss
methods.description: Parses RSASSA-PSS parameters, supporting only TLS 1.3 supported configurations.

methods.name: ParseAlgorithmIdentifier
methods.description: Parses an ASN.1 AlgorithmIdentifier, extracting OID and optional parameters.

methods.name: ParseHashAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses a hash algorithm from ASN.1 input, mapping to DigestAlgorithm.

methods.name: ParseSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses a signature algorithm ASN.1 structure, returning SignatureAlgorithm enum.

methods.name: GetTlsServerEndpointDigestAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the digest algorithm used for TLS server endpoint based on signature algorithm.
